METRO WARS [BETA 0.85]

Metro Wars is an urban tactical shooter with 7 unique AND ENTIRELY destructible maps.

VOXEL DESTRUCTION
Buildings in Metro Wars feature destructible voxels using a custom voxel engine. Use heavy ballistics and explosives to breach walls and damage structures, removing enemy cover and creating new lines of sight in real-time.

COMBAT NPC
Engage smart NPC soldiers designed to provide a persistent threat, with real pathfinding.

REALISTIC PLANE PHYSICS
Deploy in a plane to take the fight to the sky's, your entire plane has a realistic damage system with real consequences, if you get your wings shot off, you WILL not keep flying

RANKING & PROGRESSION
Progress through 50 levels to expand your arsenal of over 50 weapons.

DEV NOTES
full mobile support
